_comment: NORMATIVE cross-language fixtures for Techee device identity and signed transcripts.
Every Techee implementation (Node broker, Android/Kotlin, Windows/.NET) MUST reproduce
these byte-for-byte. If a language cannot reproduce a vector here, that language cannot
register against the broker and the divergence must be fixed before shipping.
The keypair below is a THROWAWAY generated solely for this file. It is not, and must
never be, a real device identity. It is committed on purpose so all three languages can
sign and verify identical bytes without coordinating at test time.

key.publicKeyEncoding: X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER, then standard base64 with padding, no line wrapping
key.privateKeyEncoding: PKCS#8 DER, then standard base64 (test fixture only)

deviceId._rule: deviceId = lowercase hex of SHA-256 over the SPKI DER bytes. Not the raw EC point, not PEM, not base64url. Exactly 64 chars matching /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.

signature._rule: ECDSA over P-256 with SHA-256, encoded as an ASN.1 DER SEQUENCE {INTEGER r, INTEGER s}, then standard base64. NOT IEEE-P1363 / raw r||s. Java 'SHA256withECDSA' and Node crypto.sign default to DER; .NET must request DSASignatureFormat.Rfc3279DerSequence explicitly.
signature._note: ECDSA is randomised, so a fresh signature will differ from the one below. Implementations MUST verify this vector; they cannot be expected to reproduce it.

transcripts._rule: All Techee transcripts are UTF-8, LF-joined ('\n'), with NO trailing newline. The first line is always a domain separator so a signature gathered under one protocol can never be replayed into another.

vectors.name: pinned toy vector shared with server smoke test 6d and RegistrationAuthTest
realistic vector, signable and verifiable with the fixture key

sdp.layout:
context 
 type 
 fromId 
 toId 
 fingerprintLine 
 hex(sha256(fullSdpUtf8))
sdp.fingerprintRule: The FIRST line whose leading-whitespace-trimmed form starts with 'a=fingerprint:', then .trim()'d. Trimming is required so a CRLF SDP does not leave a dangling \r inside the signed bytes.

vectors.name: offer, LF-terminated SDP
vectors.sdp:
v=0
o=- 1 1 IN IP4 0.0.0.0
s=-
a=fingerprint:sha-256 AA:BB:CC
a=setup:actpass
vectors.expectedUtf8:
techee-sdp-v1
offer
AAA
BBB
a=fingerprint:sha-256 AA:BB:CC
c309fce34e9bfdfe91013e4d3553f586da2c2d21514ba6acde095863b7450257

vectors.name: answer, CRLF SDP — the \r must be trimmed out of the fingerprint line but MUST remain inside the SDP body digest
vectors.sdp:
v=0
o=- 1 1 IN IP4 0.0.0.0
s=-
a=fingerprint:sha-256 DD:EE:FF
vectors.expectedUtf8:
techee-sdp-v1
answer
BBB
AAA
a=fingerprint:sha-256 DD:EE:FF
703c4fbc428631dd8a3cdeab28c76f8c22bafb400be6fcd0b4a7c369f5aa5e5b

vectors.name: no fingerprint — transcript is undefined and the SDP is unsignable/unverifiable by design
